title: Google Provider: Core Implementation
description:
Implement the full Google Gemini REST API provider in internal/ai/provider/google/. Follows Anthropic patterns.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Plan: docs/plans/04-provider-google.md (all sections)

Key deliverables:
- provider.go: Provider struct, New(), API() returning 'google-genai'
- request.go: Parts-based content model (text, inlineData, functionCall, functionResponse, thought, thoughtSignature), system as systemInstruction, tool as functionDeclarations
- types_wire.go: ALL wire types with camelCase JSON tags
- stream.go: Stream/StreamSimple, thinking budget/level mapping, URL with :streamGenerateContent?alt=sse
- sse_parser.go: Prompt-level blocking check, safety check BEFORE content emission, finishReason extraction
- tool_parser.go: Complete function call extraction from parts (no streaming-json-go needed)
- thought.go: Thought signature preservation, attachThoughtSignatures(), base64 encode/decode
- usage.go: Gemini usage mapping (including thoughtsTokenCount), finish reason mapping (MAX_TOKENS->StopReasonLength)
- errors.go: Google API error classification (PERMISSION_DENIED->ErrAuth, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED->ErrRateLimit)
- safety.go: Default safety settings (all OFF), isSafetyBlock helper
- Unit tests, component tests (SSE fixtures), integration tests (network-gated)
- All tests pass with -race, make check clean

Key differences from Anthropic: user/model roles, x-goog-api-key auth, camelCase wire format, complete tool calls (no delta), thoughtSignature system, safety ratings

Implementation guide: §1.1, §1.3, §4.2 (use canonical ai.IsContextOverflow), §4.6

Depends on: Anthropic Core (aiag-jj7.2) — pattern leader
